title: Sintel Faces The Cost Of Her Pursuit

cuts.voiceover_text: Sintel battles through a freezing blizzard on her frantic hunt. She is exhausted, yet refusal to stop pushes her onward.

Chasing her target into narrow, hazardous stone ruins, Sintel rushes ahead without caution. Sudden falling rubble nearly crushes her. She is terrified as crumbling walls seal off the passage, trapping her inside the dangerous canyon.

Escaping the collapse, Sintel emerges into a vast, unforgiving desert. The painful consequence of her reckless pursuit becomes painfully clear as endless dunes stretch before her. She is completely isolated and lost. With no sign of her dragon anywhere, she faces the harsh reality of her endless lonely quest.
